problem_statement: A retrieval prototype returned tactics from unrelated projects because scope filtering was applied after ranking instead of before candidate acceptance.

constraints: Multiple projects shared similar tool names
The retrieval engine optimized for lexical similarity first
Authority boundaries needed to remain project-safe

action_taken: Move scope filtering into the retrieval planning stage and reject cross-project candidates before ranking.
outcome: Cross-project leakage dropped and the remaining results became easier to explain.
failure_mode: Late filtering allowed semantically similar but unauthorized candidates to influence ranking and fusion.

when_to_apply: Projects share vocabulary or similar technical stacks
Retrieval may surface records from multiple scopes
when_not_to_apply: The retrieval surface is intentionally global and the caller explicitly requested global search
No scope boundary exists for the record class being queried
